question: In July 2025, Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said the Kaladen project between India and Myanmar will be operational by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2027**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• **Kaladan Multimodal Transit Transport Project**: The Kaladan project is a multimodal transport initiative connecting India and Myanmar to enhance regional connectivity and promote economic collaboration. The project involves **waterways, roadways, and ports**. 

• **Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal** announced in **July 2025** that the Kaladan project would be operational by **2027**, ensuring streamlined trade and transit between India and Myanmar. 

• The Kaladan project is significant for the northeast region of India, as it provides an alternative route to connect to the port in Myanmar, bypassing the chicken neck corridor and enhancing trade and strategic access. 

• The project is being developed under the **Act East Policy**, aimed at improving India's connectivity with Southeast Asia and enhancing diplomatic and economic ties.
